comments.author: Dana Whitfield
comments.body: Most noticeable on slow 3G throttling; empty art pops every poll.

content.text: Most noticeable on slow 3G throttling; empty art pops every poll.

On dashboards that already have data, each background refetch briefly mounts the empty-state illustration (cloud with No activity yet) for a flash before the loaded data paints again. First load empty state is correct when there is truly no data.

Refetch should keep showing the previous data or a subtle loading affordance, not the empty illustration. The query sets data to undefined while isFetching is true because keepPreviousData / placeholderData is not enabled on the summary query.
The flash is distracting on 15s polling and looks like a reliability bug. Enabling placeholder previous data (or gating empty state on isLoading && !data) removes the flicker.
